Nora (People Ops): Heads-up everyone 1 1 launching a short pilot and a PTO simplification next month (effective 2026-06-01).
Nora (People Ops): Pilot: Family Care Support 1 $600/year per eligible employee to help cover childcare, backup care, eldercare, or therapy sessions. Eligible after 60 days, prorated for hires.
Nora (People Ops): How to claim: submit receipts in Expensify -> account: Redwood-FamilyCare. Reimbursements processed monthly.
Sam (People Ops): PTO simplification: moving to a two-tier model for regular full-time employees: Base = 20 days/year, Leadership (managers + senior ICs) = +5 days. Removes the old 3-tier tenure bands. Accruals unchanged, carryover cap = 10 days.
Marcus (Talent): Will offers issued before 6/1 get the old bands or new?
Sam (People Ops): Offers accepted before 6/1 keep the existing terms. New offers dated 6/1+ will show the new two-tier structure.
Ava (Eng): Are part-time and contractors included in the pilot or PTO changes?
Nora (People Ops): Part-time employees get prorated Family Care Support. Contractors/contingent staff are excluded from the stipend and PTO tiers for now.
Elena (Finance): Quick note on reimbursements: Family Care reimbursements are non-taxable in some jurisdictions and taxable in others. Well include a per-country tax note in the handbook table. Finance will report any taxable payouts on payroll where required.
Sam (People Ops): International rules apply 1 local statutory minimums override these bands if they provide more generous leave. We added a country table in the handbook with specifics.
Ava (Eng): For therapy sessions that are recurring subscriptions, do we need individual receipts each month?
Nora (People Ops): Recurring subscriptions are OK if you can show proof of payment + service description. Upload the invoice and add a short note in Expensify.
Marcus (Talent): How does the carryover cap interact with unpaid leaves or parental leave?
Sam (People Ops): If you take parental leave, PTO accrual pauses per our existing policy. Carryover cap still applies; if you have complex overlap (LOA, transfers between countries) ping us and well manually reconcile.
hr-bot: Policy update posted: Family Care Support Pilot & PTO Two-Tier Simplification (effective 2026-06-01). Handbook link: https://redwood.company/hr/handbook#family-care-pilot
Nora (People Ops): Well run the pilot for 9 months, collect feedback, and iterate. Expect a short survey in mid-July.
Elena (Finance): If teams need a quick cost estimate for budgeting headcount changes, send a note to finance@redwood.company and well provide per-country cost impacts.
Ava (Eng): Thanks 1 sending to my manager to update our hiring doc. :white_check_mark:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks all. If anything unclear, book 20m with People Ops or drop questions here.
